name: MonarchAiThinkingIndicator
title: AiThinkingIndicator
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow of androidx.compose.material3.Text, androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithContent with a Brush.linearGradient for the shimmer, androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition; MonarchAiTypingDots as the default mark
summary: Shows that the assistant is working before its first token arrives: a "Thinking…" label with a soft shimmer or a pulsing mark and, after a few seconds, how long it has been thinking.
whenToUse: In the place of the assistant reply between sending a prompt and the first streamed token, especially when the wait can be long (reasoning, tool use, searching files).
whenNotToUse: Where there is no room for a sentence use MonarchAiTypingDots. To reserve the shape of the coming answer use MonarchAiResponseSkeleton. Once text streams, show the text.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiThinkingIndicator(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchAiThinkingIndicatorVariant = MonarchAiThinkingIndicatorVariant.Shimmer, label: String? = null, startedAt: Long? = null, showElapsedAfterMillis: Long = 3_000L, announce: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, elapsedLabel: ((seconds: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: variant
options.description: Shimmer: a band of the strong assistant color sweeps through the label. Mark: a pulsing mark before a still label.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Thinking…" (monarch_aithinkingindicator_label), for example "Searching your files…".

options.name: startedAt
options.description: When the assistant started working, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). null counts from when the indicator first appeared; pass it when the indicator can leave the composition during one turn, for example in a lazy list.

options.name: showElapsedAfterMillis
options.description: How long before the elapsed time appears after the label. Long.MAX_VALUE never shows it.

options.name: announce
options.description: Announces the label when the indicator appears and when the label changes.

options.name: icon
options.description: The mark of the Mark variant, given the strong assistant color as its content color; it pulses. null uses MonarchAiTypingDots. Monarch bundles no icons. Ignored by the Shimmer variant.

options.name: elapsedLabel
options.description: Formats whole elapsed seconds. By default the narrow unit format of the current locale: "5s", "1m 5s".

states.name: thinking
states.description: The label in muted text, with the shimmer or the mark.

states.name: long wait
states.description: After showElapsedAfterMillis the elapsed time follows the label in subtle text and updates every second.

states.name: animations off
states.description: The shimmer and the pulse stop; the label stays muted text and the mark is still. The clock still ticks once a second.

appearance: The label is muted text; the shimmer is a band of the strong assistant role drawn only over the label's own pixels, so contrast holds in light, dark and both high-contrast themes. The elapsed time is subtle caption text. The mark takes the strong assistant role; the default mark is MonarchAiTypingDots in its assistant roles.
platformNotes: The web shimmers a band behind the label; Android, like iOS, sweeps the assistant color through the label's own text. The web uses an assistant bot glyph as the mark; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the mark is an icon slot and falls back to MonarchAiTypingDots, which the plan named. iOS posts an announcement; Android uses an always-present polite live region holding only the label, as the web does. startedAt is epoch milliseconds (iOS takes a Date) and the delay is showElapsedAfterMillis (iOS showsElapsedAfter in seconds); announce matches MonarchAiTypingDots (iOS isAnnounced).
accessibility: The label is one TalkBack element, with the elapsed time as its state description once it shows.

The label is announced through a polite live region filled one frame after the indicator appears, and again when the label changes; the live region never holds the elapsed time, so the ticking clock is not announced.
With announce set to false there is no live region.
The mark is decorative and hidden from TalkBack.
When animations are off the shimmer and the pulse stop.
The label and the elapsed time wrap at large font sizes; nothing has a fixed height.
edgeCases: A startedAt in the future counts as 0 seconds.
Without startedAt the clock restarts if the indicator leaves the composition and comes back.
The elapsed time moves to a new line when it does not fit after a long label.
Exactly a whole minute is written without seconds: "1m".

examples.title: A long search, with a pulsing mark
examples.code:
MonarchAiThinkingIndicator(
    variant = MonarchAiThinkingIndicatorVariant.Mark,
    label = "Searching your files…",
    startedAt = startedAt,
)
